decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API sits close to the firm's established messaging platform and has been shown steadily for two years, so carrying it costs little while its value is still emerging.
Launched only in 2024 and built on existing infrastructure, the email-to-SMS gateway is a cheap option whose uncertainty has not yet resolved, which justifies keeping it.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Products A and B at minimal marginal cost, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
